name: butter-col-monorepo
description: butter-col: a service-worker web proxy with pluggable transports (Axis Network).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @axis-network/butter-transport && npm run build -w @axis-network/butter-col && npm run build -w @axis-network/bare-transport && npm run build -w butter-transport-template
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:lua
